title: TimeoutError in tls.handshake when refreshing an expired session
body:
ENVIRONMENT:

Lattice version 3.0.6; operating system macOS 15.3; server
region us-east-1.

STEPS:

How to trigger it:
- With the log window open, start refreshing an expired
  session.
- Run two workers side by side.
- Wait for the failure and read the log.

EXPECTED:

No traceback; refreshing an expired session normally takes a
few seconds.

ACTUAL:

The call never returns until the thirty-second guard fires.
It only happens when two workers run at once; a single
worker is fine.

FREQUENCY:

It occurs twice this week.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:51 in loop
lattice/ui/dialog.py:122 in on_login
lattice/auth/flow.py:59 in start
lattice/net/tls.py:161 in handshake
TimeoutError: handshake timed out after 30s (host=us-east-1)
